Its single amber chest bulb sweeps a small pool of light across the dusty damp stone floor. Its head slowly tilts up at the lifeless branches. The tree and empty brass planter socket remain rigid and dark. Sparse dust motes drift. Vast teal glass ribs overhead. Quiet, patient, tactile. Only the robot moves.
